<observations>
Date: Mar 20, 2026
* 🔴 (07:12) User enforces strict null checks in Ledgerly; switched production DB from SQLite to PostgreSQL. SOC 2 audit fieldwork starts May 19, 2026.
* 🟡 (09:05) Configured CI node_modules caching, 85% Jest coverage threshold, and Typedoc documentation.

Date: Mar 23, 2026
* 🔴 (07:05) User adopts semantic commit messages. Public API rate limit: 300 req/min.
* 🟡 (09:20) ✅ Merged PR #42 (discount code validation, reviewed by @sara).
* 🟡 (10:30) Updated Dockerfile to node:18-alpine, added LaunchDarkly feature flags (`src/flags.ts`), and refactored PDF generation to `pdf-lib`.

Date: Mar 26, 2026
* 🔴 (07:12) User enforces TypeScript strict mode repo-wide.
* 🟡 (09:50) ✅ Merged PR #58 for locale-aware date formatting after @mike approval.
* 🟡 (12:45) Added `EMAIL_SMTP_URL` notifications via nodemailer, pino JSON logging, and ConfigCat "recurringPause" toggle.

Date: Mar 29, 2026
* 🔴 (07:15) User adopted dark mode UI. Public API rate limit raised to 500 req/min.
* 🟡 (12:05) ✅ Merged `feature/dark-mode` after @sara review; deployed to staging with Percy visual tests.
* 🟡 (15:00) Added bulk `.xlsx` invoice upload endpoint (`/api/v1/invoices/bulk-upload`) using SheetJS.

Date: Apr 2, 2026
* 🔴 (07:10) User added recurring invoice templates.
* 🟡 (08:40) Implemented `/api/v1/invoices/recurring` and `pdfmake` dynamic watermark PDFs.
* 🟡 (15:05) Added BullMQ background queue for async PDF generation and CI load tests (200 concurrent).
* ✅ (17:45) Merged `feature/recurring-invoices` into develop after @kim approval.

Date: Apr 6, 2026
* 🔴 (07:15) User integrated Stripe for subscription payments.
* 🟡 (07:50) Added `stripeService.ts`, webhook endpoint `/api/v1/payments/stripe/webhook`, and receipt QR codes.
* 🟡 (15:40) Added nightly DB cleanup cron, Redis Streams for background jobs, and Snyk security scans in CI.
* ✅ (18:20) Merged `feature/stripe-integration` into main after @alex approval.
</observations>

<suggested-response>
The assistant should wait for the user to provide the next task or prompt.
</suggested-response>
